cautions: Village streets with cars at the start.
Short flights of stone and wooden steps on the lake path.
Fishing and nesting areas round the lake: keep your dog on the lead and out of the reeds.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Lases village, the APT’s start: Paese di Lases, la partenza indicata dall'APT
Vie del paese con auto alla partenza.
textIt.Short flights of stone and wooden steps: Brevi rampe di gradini in pietra e in legno sul sentiero del lago.
textIt.Fishing and nesting areas round the lake: Zone di pesca e di nidificazione intorno al lago: tieni il cane al guinzaglio e fuori dal canneto.
